fields.name: q3_guide_surprise
fields.question: What does the company guide Q3 FY2027 revenue to, against the ~$104.2bn the street carries?
fields.prior: Street ~$104.2bn (+~83% y/y), as of 25 Aug previews. NVIDIA guides a point with a +/-2% band; the guide is the number the stock trades on.
fields.resolution_rule: Read the guidance paragraph of the CFO commentary. Record the midpoint in $bn and the band. Surprise = midpoint - 104.2.

fields.name: gross_margin_surprise
fields.question: Non-GAAP gross margin, reported and guided, against ~75%?
fields.prior: Company guided ~75% for Q2. The live question is whether HBM cost inflation is being absorbed or passed through, and what the Q3 guide implies.
fields.resolution_rule: Record reported non-GAAP GM and the Q3 GM guide. Surprise = reported - 75.0. A Q3 GM guide below 74% is the bear trigger regardless of the revenue line.

fields.name: HBM_cost_pressure
fields.question: Does management quantify memory cost inflation, and does it flow to price?
fields.prior: Micron reports ~$22bn of committed long-term supply and tightness into 2027; customers were notified (22 Aug) of AI-system price rises above 15% for some early-2027 systems, linked to HBM. So the cost is real and the pass-through is attempted; whether it holds is unknown.
fields.resolution_rule: ordinal in {absorbed, passed_through, partially_passed, not_addressed}, plus any quantified figure. This is the MECHANISM behind field 2 and it forecasts the next three quarters, not this one.

fields.name: Rubin_timing_change
fields.question: Is Rubin on schedule, and what does the ramp language change?
fields.prior: Rubin debut is the quarter's headline product question. Foxconn has said rack production prepares to start in Q4.
fields.resolution_rule: ordinal in {ahead, on_schedule, slipped, not_addressed}. Record the exact ramp phrasing -- 'production' vs 'sampling' vs 'volume' are different claims. A slip is a bigger fact than a revenue miss because it moves FY2028.

fields.name: customer_financing_quality
fields.question: How much of the demand is internally funded, and how much is financing-dependent?
fields.prior: NVIDIA has helped arrange very large AI-infrastructure financing and carries commitments connected to the buildout, while AI-related corporate borrowing has grown quickly. This is the question the street has started asking and nobody has a number for.
fields.resolution_rule: ordinal in {not_addressed, addressed_qualitatively, quantified}. Record any figure for vendor financing, backstops, guarantees or receivable concentration. NOT_ADDRESSED is itself informative and must be recorded as such, not left blank.

fields.name: future_capacity_constraint
fields.question: What is named as the binding constraint on the next four quarters?
fields.prior: Candidates: CoWoS/advanced packaging, HBM supply, power availability, grid interconnect, or none.
fields.resolution_rule: ordinal in {packaging, memory, power, grid, none, not_addressed}. The named constraint decides which SUPPLIER the demand actually reaches -- it is the single most useful field for the propagation graph.

fields.name: datacenter_surprise
fields.question: Data Center revenue against the ~$85bn the street carries?
fields.prior: Q1 Data Center was $75.2bn, +92% y/y. Street around $85bn for Q2.
fields.resolution_rule: Record reported Data Center revenue in $bn. Surprise = reported - 85.0.

fields.name: hyperscale_growth
fields.question: What share of Data Center revenue is the large cloud customers, and is concentration rising?
fields.prior: Recent 10-Qs disclose significant customer concentration. AWS backlog ~$496bn with 2026 capex ~$220bn; Alphabet 2026 capex ~$195-205bn.
fields.resolution_rule: Record the disclosed large-customer percentage if given. Rising concentration raises the financing question in field 5 rather than settling it.

fields.name: custom_silicon_competition
fields.question: Does the print or the call acknowledge accelerating custom-silicon substitution?
fields.prior: Google/Marvell arrangement worth up to ~$120bn to Marvell through FY2033 if targets are met. Hyperscalers are building substitutes; that is a fact regardless of tonight.
fields.resolution_rule: ordinal in {denied, acknowledged, quantified, not_addressed}. Higher value = MORE competition. The graph's AVGO/MRVL nodes are signed off THIS field.

fields.name: Blackwell_demand
fields.question: Blackwell shipment/demand language: sold out, in balance, or normalising?
fields.prior: The prior cycle's language was persistent supply shortage.
fields.resolution_rule: ordinal in {sold_out, tight, in_balance, normalising, not_addressed}.

fields.name: ACIE_growth
fields.question: Non-data-centre segments (auto, robotics, gaming, professional viz) -- growth and any inflection?
fields.prior: Small relative to Data Center; matters only as an option on a second engine.
fields.resolution_rule: Record segment revenue and y/y growth. A surprise here is a change in the STORY, not in the quarter.

fields.name: China_optional_revenue
fields.question: Is any China revenue included in guidance, or explicitly excluded?
fields.prior: Recent guidance practice has been to exclude uncertain China revenue, making it a free option on the guide rather than a component of it.
fields.resolution_rule: ordinal in {excluded, partially_included, included, not_addressed}, plus any $ figure. EXCLUDED is bullish for the quality of the guide in field 1.

fields.name: revenue_surprise
fields.question: Q2 headline revenue against consensus ~$92.05bn?
fields.prior: Consensus ~$92.05bn (+96.9% y/y) as of 25 Aug, ABOVE the company's own May guide of $91bn +/-2%. Adjusted EPS ~$2.07.
fields.resolution_rule: Record reported revenue in $bn. Surprise = reported - 92.05. RANKED LAST ON PURPOSE: the quarter is nine weeks old and largely pre-announced by the supply chain; the guide is the news.
